note: CH-11 tuned variant (one variable: peak learning rate 0.000833 -> 0.0001, the RT-DETR paper's AdamW rate). optimizer and momentum are set explicitly only so that lr0 is not ignored: AdamW with beta1 0.9 is what optimizer=auto picks for the baseline; weight decay, warmup and the linear schedule stay the same. Hypothesis, stated before training: the Ultralytics auto rate is tuned for CNN YOLO heads; a DETR-style lower rate may disturb the pretrained transformer less and converge more smoothly, but may also learn the 8-class head more slowly within 6 epochs.
